sentiment.rationale: The document reports full-year 2025 revenue of $65.2B (up 45%) and EPS of $24.21 (up 86%), with Q4 revenue up 43% and key products up 91%. Forward guidance for 2026 revenue of $80B to $83B (about 25% growth at the midpoint) and EPS of $33.50 to $35.00 represents a meaningful raise from the prior year's actuals, indicating strong organic momentum. However, the document also notes pricing headwinds (low to mid-teens drag, US realized prices down 7% in Q4) and Medicaid coverage losses, which temper the score below +0.7.

summary.revenue: Full-year 2025 revenue $65.2B, up 45%. Q4 revenue up 43%, with key products above $13B in the quarter, up 91%.
summary.eps: Non-GAAP EPS $24.21, up 86%. Q4 EPS $7.54 (including $0.52 of acquired IPR&D charges) vs $5.32 in 2024.
summary.guidance: 2026 revenue guided to $80B to $83B, about 25% growth at the midpoint. 2026 EPS guided to $33.50 to $35.00. Performance margin guided to 46% to 47.5%.
summary.margin: Gross margin 83.2%. Non-GAAP performance margin 47.2%, up 4.2 percentage points vs Q4 2024.
key_risks: Pricing expected to drag growth by a low to mid-teens percentage, with US realized prices down 7% in Q4.
California and other states removing Medicaid obesity coverage in 2026.
Execution risk on the orforglipron launch across more than 40 countries.
key_opportunities: Foundayo (orforglipron) obesity pill approved and launching with supply already doubled.
Key products up 91% in Q4, driven by incretin franchise momentum.
Expanded manufacturing capacity, exceeding goal to produce 1.8 times the number of incretin doses in 2025 vs 2024.
